faq.q: What does a how-to video template include?
faq.a: A demo frame for one task, plus an AI avatar, a voice, and a script. Put your product in the frame. You do not book a person for this lesson.

faq.q: How does the template become a video?
faq.a: Paste the listing link or drop in the product photo, then write the line you want heard. What comes back is a clip you can post. If a pause feels long, shorten it before the file goes up.

faq.q: Why use this instead of hiring someone to film the task?
faq.a: You can change the spoken line after the first version, and the spend stays on the monthly plan. A creator's afternoon locks you to one version.

faq.q: Who gets the most from a how-to like this?
faq.a: A founder filming between orders, and a small team that owes a client a demo before the week ends. If the product has a move a buyer must copy, this frame fits.

faq.q: Can I do this if I have never edited a video?
faq.a: Yes. A photo of the product is enough to start, even if you have never edited a video.

faq.q: Which products fit a how-to template?
faq.a: A product with one move a shopper must copy. The spoken line can name that move. Swap the photo when the next product needs the same shape.

faq.q: Can the how-to use files from my shop?
faq.a: Yes. A logo in the corner and a clip you already shot can both go in. The product in the photo should be the one you ship.

faq.q: Where can I post the finished how-to?
faq.a: Match the frame to the placement. Use 9:16 for a phone story, 1:1 for a square tile, and 16:9 for a wide screen. 4:3 and 3:4 sit in the same picker.

faq.q: Do I pay to use a template?
faq.a: Yes. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. A 6-second clip is 24 credits, 10 seconds is 40, 15 is 60, and 30 is 120. A photo spends 24 credits. If a job fails, those credits come back.

faq.q: Can I run the how-to in ads and in client work?
faq.a: Yes. A client handoff and a paid placement can use the same clip, and the download has no watermark.

faq.q: Why not build the ad from a blank file?
faq.a: This frame is already a lesson, so the hour can go to the product and the step. A blank timeline asks you to invent that shape.
